title: Freelands Foundation Announces £100,000 Annually for Three UK Arts Organizations
summary: The Freelands Foundation has awarded £100,000 (approximately $135,000) of unrestricted funding to three organizations annually for the next five years, totaling £1.5m (roughly $2 million). summary: The Academy of Natural Sciences at Drexel University, in Philadelphia, will close permanently at the end of the month, citing low attendance and rising costs. title: Lucien Smith, Whose Meteoric Rise Presaged a Diverse Second Act, Dies at 37
summary: Lucien Smith, an artist whose career spanned painting, public projects, and restaurants, has died at the age of thirty-seven. title: Lonnie G. Bunch III Resigns as Secretary of the Smithsonian
summary: Historian Lonnie G. Bunch III, who has served as secretary of the Smithsonian since 2019, has announced that he is leaving the institution. title: Japan Art Association Announces 2026 Praemium Imperiale Laureates
summary: Laureates for the thirty-seventh iteration of the Praemium Imperiale, awarded by the Japan Art Association, were announced on September 8. The recipients of the 15 million yen prize (approximately $95,000), are Jenny Holzer (painting), Andy Goldsworthy (sculpture), Daniel Libeskind (architecture), Herbert Blomstedt (music), and Cate Blanchett (theater/film).
